tree.description: A titled card for a cascading outline, holding outline_branch and outline_item children.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The always-visible section header. Without one (and no subtitle either) the header strip is omitted.

attributes.name: subtitle
attributes.description: A muted line under the title.

branch.description: An expandable row (native details/summary) that reveals a body of nested markdown or further outline_branch children.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The row title. Without one the row shows an 'untitled section' placeholder.

attributes.name: num
attributes.description: A leading marker rendered verbatim, for example num="2." to include the dot.

attributes.name: meta
attributes.description: Muted text at the end of the row.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: A small glyph at the start of the row.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Starts the branch expanded. Written bare, for example {open}. Without it the branch starts collapsed.

item.description: A terminal row with no detail to expand, styled like an outline_branch's summary but without a chevron.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The row label, used when the directive has no bracket content. Bracket content wins when both are written.

attributes.name: num
attributes.description: A leading marker rendered verbatim, for example num="2." to include the dot.

attributes.name: meta
attributes.description: Muted text at the end of the row.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: A small glyph at the start of the row.
